article.story: DAVIDSON, N.C. -- — Keyshuan Tillery's 26 points helped Charlotte defeat Davidson 73-66 on Tuesday. Tillery added seven rebounds for the 49ers (3-2). Frank Oguche scored 10 points. Josh Scovens finished with 17 points for the Wildcats (3-2). John Carter Jr. added 14 points and two steals. Charlotte took the lead with 18:42 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Tillery led his team in scoring with 10 points to help put them ahead 38-22 at the break. Up next: Both teams play again on Monday. Charlotte plays Florida Gulf Coast and Davidson squares off against Northern Iowa. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
